statement: The original January-April 2018 SEC archive part 7 contains initial Inferent brochure 288939 version 1, member 292027_288939_1_20180301.pdf, with 14 physical pages. The printed date is March 2018; March 1 is independently supported by historical Base A FilingID 1166838.

Initial brochure Item 2 describes its initial Part 2A with the registration application; Item 4 reports no current client assets under management and expects eligibility within 120 days from the effective initial-registration date, not necessarily the filing date.
All 14 freshly extracted initial-brochure pages contain no Bleich or Ophir text. This limited negative cannot identify employees or establish nonemployment, nonownership or absence of a transaction.

Original historical Base A, exact CRD field 1E1=292027, supplies six Inferent FilingIDs: 1166838,1212685,1227321,1231177,1237606,1278683. Exact FilingID joins classify the initial March 1, 2018 request, four other-than-annual 2018 amendments, and the March 6, 2019 annual update.

All six Inferent Base A snapshots answer Item 4A=N with 4B blank, and none has an exact FilingID row in the Schedule D section 4 table. The form limits this to succession at the time of filing and excludes repeat reporting. This does not establish absence of an Ophir merger or another transaction.

The original 120-day representation table has Representation 1 and Representation 2 marked Y for Inferent FilingIDs 1166838 and 1212685. This is consistent with the initial brochure registration context and does not establish the actual effective registration date.
Item 5A reports three employees in each retrieved 2018 Inferent Base A row and eight in March 2019. Aggregate headcounts do not identify Bleich or date his employment.

The same CRD 313946 appears in two Base A rows with different name and SEC-file fields: July 12, 2021 ENTRYPOINT CAPITAL / 801-122062, and June 27, 2024 ENTRYPOINT CAPITAL, LLC / 801-130798. The original filing-type table marks Initial SEC Registration Request=Y for both IDs1542238 and1869875; ID1869875 additionally has Final SEC ERA Report=Y, whereas ID1542238 leaves that field blank. Exact CRD continuity, differing fields and the dual2024flags are verified; their cause and corporate legal history remain unresolved.

The Base A original CSV payload is preserved through an exact 95,465,915-byte compressed ZIP local member, reconstructing 533,213,713 bytes with verified CRC32, size and SHA256. The expanded CSV remains outside the investigation in a work cache; target extracts are derivatives.
